data.name: Poglings
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Sunscrest Island!

Poglings is a creature raising and racing adventure set on the vibrant shores of Suncrest Island, a place where ancient magic sleeps beneath sun drenched canopies and forgotten ruins. Hatch mysterious eggs, nurture whimsical creatures called Poglings, train them to become champions, and uncover a sweeping story about the bond between humans and the magical beings they once called friends.

Part creature collector, part racing game, and part island exploration, Poglings blends cozy gameplay with an epic, story driven quest that takes you from peaceful beaches to cosmic realms and shadowy valleys.

Hatch, Raise, and Bond

Every journey begins with a single egg washed ashore. Pick it up, build a nest, and watch your first Pogling hatch. From there, it's on you to take care of them. Feed them, bathe them, let them rest, and show them some love. Happy Poglings grow stronger and leave you little gifts. Neglect them, and they'll let you know.

As you explore Suncrest Island, you'll find more eggs hiding in unexpected places. Each Pogling is different. Some are fast, some can fly, and others are built for strength or swimming. Train them using equipment you build around your villa, or catch critters and forage berries across the island to boost their abilities. When a Pogling masters a skill, you can take them to an ancient shrine and watch them transform into something incredible.

Once they're ready, it's time to race. The island is home to forgotten racing grounds, each with its own track designed around a different skill. Start small, get better, rank up, and eventually take on opponents that will push your best Poglings to their limits.

But there's more going on beneath the surface. The island holds secrets, ancient ruins, and a story about a lost bond between humans and Poglings that you're meant to restore. Along the way you'll meet a cast of characters who'll help you, and challenge you.

The story takes you from sunny beaches to cosmic realms and into the shadow of an ancient villain who isn't going to go quietly.

data.short_description: Hatch, raise, and race magical creatures on a mysterious island brimming with ancient secrets. Train your Poglings, then race them through whimsical tracks in this cozy creature raising adventure blending island exploration, an epic story driven quest, and the thrill of building ultimate champions.
